patterns.description: Reject translation/verification when no adequate semantics is available.
patterns.soundness_condition: No success result may be produced for the unsupported source behavior.
patterns.proof_effect: Narrows the accepted source-language subset; preserves theorem validity for accepted inputs.
patterns.example_basis: CompCert semantic-preservation theorem is conditional on successful compilation.
patterns.anneal_use: Default fail-closed handling when Charon/Aeneas/Lean correspondence is not justified.

patterns.description: Represent the operation by a relation over arguments, state, observations, result, and post-state.
patterns.soundness_condition: The actual operation refines/is included in the formal relation, and the relation satisfies the simulation/frame laws required by surrounding transformations.
patterns.proof_effect: Compiler/translator correctness can be parametric in the operation while leaving its implementation outside the verified component.
patterns.anneal_use: Appropriate for modeled externals, intrinsics, or other effects whose implementation is intentionally outside the translator.

patterns.description: Make environmental behavior an explicit semantic oracle/specification and state a premise connecting concrete execution to it.
patterns.soundness_condition: Concrete external code and calling convention satisfy the modeled oracle/specification.
patterns.proof_effect: End-to-end theorem is conditional on an explicit environment premise.
patterns.example_basis: CakeML FFI oracle and PLDI 2019 verified-processor result.
patterns.anneal_use: Appropriate where a Rust-level theorem intentionally trusts an external API/model.

patterns.description: Permit a superset of real behaviors in the formal model.
patterns.soundness_condition: All real behaviors are included; state/effect/termination dimensions are overapproximated too, not only return values.
patterns.proof_effect: Safety proofs become stronger/harder but can soundly cover the real operation after inclusion is justified.
patterns.example_basis: Derived refinement principle illustrated by relational external-call models.
patterns.anneal_use: Useful for intentionally conservative modeling when exact semantics is unnecessary.

patterns.description: Remove the operation or replace it with a semantics that admits fewer or different behaviors.
patterns.soundness_condition: Requires a separate proof that erased behavior is irrelevant/equivalent for the claimed property.
patterns.proof_effect: Without such a proof, target correctness does not imply source correctness.
patterns.example_basis: CompCert inline-assembly warning illustrates the danger of a formal placeholder that does not match concrete behavior.
patterns.anneal_use: Do not use merely because the translator cannot model the source operation.

representation_warnings.warning: Usually still implies functional/pure behavior unless state, effects, partiality, and nondeterminism are explicit.
Means implementation is hidden; it does not by itself determine whether semantics is pure, deterministic, total, stateful, or effectful.
Representation or parsing success is not semantic support for the intended theorem.
